Serving clients since 2017

A Ugandan company built on safe, reliable transport

Established in 2017, Darlwhinnie Logistics Solutions Ltd provides dependable logistics, vehicle leasing and car hire to businesses, organisations and individuals. We are committed to safe, reliable, customer-focused transport that meets our clients' changing needs.

Our experienced team works with professionalism and integrity to deliver on time, while holding high standards of safety and operational excellence.

Vision

To be a leading provider of reliable logistics and mobility solutions in Uganda and the East African region.

Mission

To deliver efficient, safe and customer-focused logistics and transportation solutions through professionalism, innovation and operational excellence.

Core values

Integrity

We conduct our business with honesty, transparency and the highest ethical standards in every interaction.

Reliability

We deliver dependable services on time, so our clients can trust us to meet their expectations.

Professionalism

We uphold excellence through skilled personnel, quality service and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Customer focus

We put our clients at the centre of everything we do, with tailored solutions that meet their unique needs and exceed their expectations.

What we offer

Three services, one team that keeps your goods and people moving.

Logistics solutions

Efficient, secure and timely movement of goods. We work closely with you to build transport solutions that cut delays and raise efficiency, from routine deliveries to specialised transport requirements.

Car leasing

Cost-effective, flexible mobility without the burden of owning vehicles. Well-maintained, reliable vehicles under customised leasing arrangements, for short-term projects and long-term operations.

Car hire

Convenient, affordable hire for business and personal travel. A diverse, well-maintained fleet for short- and long-term rental: corporate assignments, airport transfers, special events and personal trips.

Why Darlwhinnie

Our experienced management team combines industry expertise with a commitment to operational excellence, so every client gets professional, reliable support. We aim to exceed expectations and build lasting partnerships based on trust and performance.

  • Well-maintained fleet
  • Competitive pricing
  • Flexible transport solutions
  • Commitment to safety and quality

Regional reach

We have grown steadily to serve clients beyond Kampala, across Uganda and the wider East African region. Our expanding network and well-coordinated fleet operations deliver consistent, reliable service wherever clients need us, with the same professionalism and safety standards we started with.

Leadership

Ambrose Tugume

Ambrose is a logistics and supply chain professional with over 25 years of experience in logistics, transportation, procurement, warehousing and supply chain management across East Africa. His strategic leadership drives operational excellence and customer satisfaction at Darlwhinnie.

He has held senior leadership positions at leading organisations:

  • East African Breweries Limited
  • Serengeti Breweries Limited
  • Kenya Breweries Limited
  • Kasese Cobalt Company

He holds a Bachelor of Arts (Social Sciences) from Makerere University and a Postgraduate Diploma in Supply Chain Management from Uganda Management Institute. He is a Member of the Chartered Institute of Logistics and Transport (CILT).
